_doc: Kickers left OFF the season miss-leaders board (released / unattached). Read by rescan.py (viewA_top10) and regenerate.sh (board rows). Match is by athleteId when present, else case-insensitive full name. Their misses still count in season totals/allKickers (flagged excluded:true); they just don't take a board slot. Remove an entry if the kicker signs with a team again.
